selected_script.angle: Preventing dining room rugs from curling or sliding when pulling out heavy dining chairs
selected_script.hook: Pulling out a dining chair shouldn't turn into a wrestling match with your rug.

segment_01.spoken_english: Pulling out a dining chair shouldn't turn into a wrestling match with your rug. Look at this corner curling up every single time I move my chair.

segment_02.spoken_english: I added these ultra-thin, flat L-shaped stickers to the underside corners. Since they're completely flat, you don't even know they're there under the rug.

segment_03.spoken_english: Now my rug stays perfectly flat and won't shift at all, even when dragging heavy chairs. It's an instant upgrade for my dining room.
